theorems.name: Submission.cmcsd_sh_measure_compl_support_eq_zero
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) S.support → S ω = 0) → ∀ (P k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)), (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → X.massOn W = μ W) → μ X.supportᶜ = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
